column1: This file was created using the 202605 CRSP database.
It contains value-weighted returns for the intersections of  2 ME portfolios
The portfolios are constructed on the last Friday of June.  ME is market cap on the last Friday
of June.  BE/ME is book equity at the last fiscal year end of the prior calendar
year divided by ME at the end of December of the prior year.
Weekly portfolio returns are formed from weekly stock returns (computed from the first to the last trading day of the week).
Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
